messages:
maria: Heads up — deploy-bot is holding the staging canary promo for release branch because the CI build cache lease acquire is throttling. deploybot job 7890 is failing :warning:

tom: Looking into it. Quick log excerpt:```ERROR lease.acquire: throttle_exceeded - attempt=3 backoff=0.5s```

lisa: Can we just pin to last-good image sha to unblock the promotion?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: job=7890 status=FAILED reason=lease_acquire_throttle attempts=3 - aborting canary promotion

tom: I can do a manual pin to the last known good: `registry.redwood/service@sha256:abcd1234` if we want to proceed.

aj: +1 for pinning and promoting after a smoke. Also filing infra ticket. tagging sre-oncall / @sre-bot for context.

sre-bot: sre-bot: Observed a spike in lease requests from concurrent CI runs earlier today, exceeded throttle threshold. Temporary mitigations: reduce CI parallelism, increase retry backoff. Runbook link: https://go/runbooks/cache-lease-throttle

maria: We should also draft a short release note: "temporary pin to previous image to avoid cache lease throttling" and call out the change window — currently still open but need to notify stakeholders.

lisa: I'll update release-notes and post an FYI to #release-notes and #customers. ETA for pin + smoke ~20m.

tom: Manual pin applied: `kubectl set image deployment/foo foo=registry.redwood/service@sha256:abcd1234 -n staging` — rolling restart started.

maria: Starting smoke tests: `curl -sS https://staging.api.redwood/health | jq .status` -> "ok" (3/3 endpoints responding).

aj: Canary promotion approved once smoke passes. I'll kick the promote job and monitor.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promote-job=7895 queued by=@aj status=QUEUED

tom: After promote succeeds, follow-up action: SRE to increase cache lease pool or tune CI parallelism to avoid recurrence.

sre-bot: Created infra ticket CACHE-4321, assigned to infra-team, summary: "cache lease throttle during heavy CI runs". Proposed fixes: bump lease pool + cap CI default parallelism to 4.

lisa: Posting customer-facing note draft to #product. Will mention temporary pin and that we validated smoke before promotion.

maria: :thumbsup: Release unblocked. Leaving this thread open for postmortem notes — will add links to incident doc and the infra ticket.

(automated) deploy-bot: job 7895 completed SUCCESS - canary promoted.

maria: Unblocked and promoted to staging/prod per change window. Follow-up: postmortem + rollout of cache throttle tuning next week.
__meta: generated for dataset: release/deploy coordination - CI/CD cache lease throttle; unique Slack thread style
